evidence: Wu et al. profiled 26 breast tumors with scRNA-seq. Their six-sample spatial cohort includes four tumors from that scRNA-seq cohort (CID4535, CID4290, CID44971 and CID4465), plus two additional tumors. Matching therefore applies to a subset, not every sample.
The GEO record contains single-cell data; spatial count matrices, spot metadata and H&E images are separately deposited at Zenodo 4739739.

The GEO experimental design describes a matched-section comparison of three imaging platforms and paired Chromium FLEX scRNA-seq. This accession specifically deposits the CosMx component. The study includes 17 tumor and 16 normal tissue types; sample-level pairing and access to the other modalities must be checked in the linked publication.

The GEO record identifies scRNA-seq of human intestinal samples and membership in parent study GSE284232. The associated publication, Spatial fibroblast niches define Crohn’s fistulae, describes the spatial expression atlas. This accession is the scRNA-seq component; the parent study links the other modalities. Donor matching has not been independently established here.
